raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`TokenizerManager.collect_metrics` adds the full prompt length to `sglang:prompt_tokens_total` for every finished request, including requests that were aborted before any forward pass. In PD disaggregation this happens on every bootstrap failure and every KV transfer failure, including the decode-side aborts triggered by client disconnects while the request is still in the prealloc or transfer queue. These requests processed no prompt tokens, and their `cached_tokens` is 0.

As a result, under an abort storm `prompt_tokens_total` is inflated while `cached_tokens_total` is not. Any uncached-token figure derived as `prompt - cached` is inflated too, and so is the apparent prefill load.

We have also implemented early rejection, which rejects a request at admission when its predicted TTFT exceeds a threshold, and plan to upstream it. Without this fix, every rejected request would add its full prompt length to `prompt_tokens_total` even though it never runs, which makes the metric noticeably too high.

## Modifications

- `collect_metrics`: when a finished request has `finish_reason.type == "abort"` and the scheduler never set its `forward_entry_time`, report 0 prompt tokens. The scheduler time stats are already part of every batch output, so this adds no new IPC fields and needs no scheduler changes.
- Requests aborted after entering forward, as well as normal completions, are counted as before. If time stats are unavailable, the previous behaviour is kept.
- `num_requests_total` and the e2e latency histogram are unchanged and still count every finished request.
- Added `test/registered/unit/managers/test_tokenizer_manager_abort_prompt_tokens.py`. It covers an abort before forward, an abort after forward, a normal finish, and the missing-time-stats fallback.

How aborted requests are counted after this change:

| Case | Prompt tokens counted |
|---|---|
| PD prefill bootstrap failure | 0 (was: full prompt) |
| PD decode KV transfer failure, including `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_WAITING_TIMEOUT` and client disconnects during prealloc/transfer | 0 (was: full prompt) |
| Aborted while running, including `SGLANG_REQ_RUNNING_TIMEOUT` (requires `forward_entry_time > 0`) | full prompt (unchanged) |
| PD prefill KV transfer failure after the forward pass | full prompt (unchanged) |
| Invalid input or grammar failure (`set_finish_with_abort` shrinks the input to one token and runs one forward) | 1 (unchanged) |
| Aborted in the waiting queue, including `SGLANG_REQ_WAITING_TIMEOUT` | not counted; these are answered with `AbortReq` through `_handle_abort_req` and never reach `collect_metrics` (unchanged) |

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This changes metrics only and does not affect model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. The change adds one field lookup per finished request.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

                 time_per_output_token=time_per_output_token,
             )
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _entered_forward(recv_obj, i: int) -> bool:
+        # Without scheduler time stats, keep counting as before.
+        time_stats = recv_obj.time_stats
+        if not time_stats or i >= len(time_stats):

     def dump_requests(self, state: ReqState, out_dict: dict):
         if self.dump_requests_exclude_meta_keys and isinstance(
             out_dict.get("meta_info"), dict

@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+"""Unit tests for prompt-token accounting of aborted requests in TokenizerManager.
+
+A request aborted before its first forward (e.g. a PD bootstrap or KV transfer
+failure) processed no prompt tokens, so it must not add its prompt length to
+sglang:prompt_tokens_total.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import DisaggregationMode  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import (  # noqa: E402
+    ReqState,
+    TokenizerManager,
+)
+from sglang.srt.observability.req_time_stats import (  # noqa: E402
+    APIServerReqTimeStats,
+    SchedulerReqTimeStats,
+)
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PROMPT_TOKENS = 1000
+
+
+def _make_manager():
+    tm = TokenizerManager.__new__(TokenizerManager)
+    tm.metrics_collector = MagicMock()
+    tm.metrics_collector.labels = {}
+    tm.enable_priority_scheduling = False
+    tm.disaggregation_mode = DisaggregationMode.NULL
+    tm._request_has_grammar = lambda obj: False
+    return tm
+
+
+def _make_state():
+    obj = SimpleNamespace(custom_labels=None, stream=False)
+    state = ReqState([], True, MagicMock(), obj, APIServerReqTimeStats())
+    state.ttft_observed = True
+    state.last_completion_tokens = 0
+    return state
+
+
+def _make_output(finish_type, forward_entry_time, with_time_stats=True):
+    time_stats = None
+    if with_time_stats:
+        stats = SchedulerReqTimeStats()
+        stats.forward_entry_time = forward_entry_time
+        time_stats = [stats]
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        completion_tokens=[0],
+        prompt_tokens=[PROMPT_TOKENS],
+        cached_tokens=[0],
+        finished_reasons=[{"type": finish_type}],
+        time_stats=time_stats,
+    )
+
+
+class TestAbortPromptTokens(CustomTestCase):
+    def _observed_prompt_tokens(self, recv_obj):
+        tm = _make_manager()
+        tm.collect_metrics(_make_state(), recv_obj, 0)
+        args = tm.metrics_collector.observe_one_finished_request.call_args.args
+        return args[1]
+
+    def test_abort_before_forward_counts_no_prompt_tokens(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._observed_prompt_tokens(_make_output("abort", 0.0)), 0)
+
+    def test_abort_after_forward_counts_prompt_tokens(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._observed_prompt_tokens(_make_output("abort", 1.0)), PROMPT_TOKENS
+        )
+
+    def test_normal_finish_counts_prompt_tokens(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._observed_prompt_tokens(_make_output("stop", 1.0)), PROMPT_TOKENS
+        )
+
+    def test_abort_without_time_stats_keeps_counting(self):
+        recv_obj = _make_output("abort", 0.0, with_time_stats=False)
+        self.assertEqual(self._observed_prompt_tokens(recv_obj), PROMPT_TOKENS)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
